# Configuration

The bridge reads its settings from environment variables (or a `.env` file in the directory it is run from).

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ATB_DATA_DIR` | `data` | data folder (SQLite database and `master.key`) |
| `ATB_DATABASE_URL` | empty | database URL; empty means SQLite inside `ATB_DATA_DIR`. For PostgreSQL: `postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@host:5432/db` |
| `ATB_MASTER_KEY` | empty | encryption key (32 bytes, base64). Empty means it is generated once and stored in `master.key` |
| `ATB_ADMIN_USERNAME` | `admin` | name of the first administrator (only when no user exists) |
| `ATB_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | empty | password of the first administrator, at least 10 characters |
| `ATB_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | listen address |
| `ATB_PORT` | `8750` | port |
| `ATB_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | `127.0.0.1:*,localhost:*,[::1]:*` | allowed values of the Host header for `/mcp` (protection against DNS rebinding) |
| `ATB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | empty | allowed Origin values for browser-based MCP clients |
| `ATB_STATIC_DIR` | empty | folder of the built dashboard (`frontend/dist`); empty means the dashboard is not served |
| `ATB_SESSION_HOURS` | `12` | lifetime of a user session (hours) |
| `ATB_APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS` | `900` | time allowed to decide on and use an approval (seconds) |
| `ATB_APPROVAL_WAIT_SECONDS` | `25.0` | how long a tool call waits for the human decision (seconds) |
| `ATB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | `15.0` | SSH connection timeout (seconds) |
| `ATB_JOB_POLL_SECONDS` | `0.4` | longest interval between status checks of running commands (seconds) |

## Docker Compose variables (in `.env`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ATB_BIND` | `127.0.0.1` | address on which the port is published on the Docker host |
| `ATB_PUBLISH_PORT` | `8750` | host port |
| `ATB_DOMAIN` | empty | domain for the `https` profile |
| `ATB_EXTRA_HOSTS` | empty | additional host names allowed for `/mcp`, for example `192.168.1.10:*` |
| `ATB_SUBNET` | `172.31.250.0/24` | internal Compose subnet; only the proxy inside it is trusted |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | empty | PostgreSQL password for the `postgres` profile |
| `NODE_IMAGE`, `PYTHON_IMAGE`, `CADDY_IMAGE`, `POSTGRES_IMAGE` | official images | for using another registry |

## Client-side variables

| Variable | Use |
|---|---|
| `ATB_URL` | bridge address for `atb mcp-stdio`, `atb call` and the example script |
| `ATB_AGENT_TOKEN` | assistant token for the same |
| `ATB_NEW_PASSWORD` | password for `atb create-user` without an interactive prompt |
